correctness.rationale: Exact rank-two RREF enumeration of all 896260 two-spaces independently confirms 2016 all-smooth pencils. A second implementation counts 576 individual smooth forms, both smooth PGL3 orbits certified over the algebraic closure by three-chart Jacobian Groebner bases. Full 5616-element projective group closure yields pencil orbits 1872 and 144. Three-chart complete-intersection Groebner bases, irreducible P12/P3, tangent transversality at all 13 rational points and Bezout length25 certify the base-scheme decomposition; the dimension cap follows by linear algebra on tangent spaces. No extrapolation to general q.

value.rationale: All-smooth linear systems are a motivated finite-field Bertini problem; the minimal plane-filling Tallini family forces a natural 13-point rational base configuration. The two complete pencil orbits have geometrically different residual degree12 schemes (separable degree12 versus a nonreduced cubic of multiplicity4), a nontrivial boundary for base-point transversality and arithmetic geometry of blowups. These intersection invariants are not determined by single-curve counts, automorphism groups or general existence theorems; classification is complete rather than an arbitrary sample.
